plugin-data.name: IndexNow
plugin-data.description: Tells search engines like Bing, Yandex, Naver and Seznam when you publish, change or delete a page, so they crawl it right away. Your page URLs are sent to api.indexnow.org. Google does not use IndexNow.

key-file-tip: Search engines read this file to verify the site is yours.
not-public-site: The URL of this site is not public, nothing is going to be submitted. Check the Site URL in the settings.
